novel_features.name: Watch list management
novel_features.description: Track a personal set of YC companies and see what changes between syncs.
novel_features.rationale: Local SQLite watch table — no online source exposes per-user portfolio state.
novel_features.example: yc-companies-pp-cli watch add stripe airbnb doordash
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when an agent needs to compare a list of YC companies across syncs without re-uploading the slug list each time.

novel_features.name: Watch diff
novel_features.description: Show team_size, status, and hiring changes on your watched companies since a prior snapshot.
novel_features.rationale: Joins two companies_history snapshots filtered to watched slugs. No API exposes historical state.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when an agent is asked 'what changed on these YC companies recently' and needs structured delta rows, not a fresh full list.

novel_features.name: New companies since date
novel_features.description: Companies that appeared in the directory after a date or since the last sync.
novel_features.rationale: Anti-join across snapshots. Static endpoints never expose deltas.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this for 'what's new in YC' questions — the only correct answer requires snapshot history.

novel_features.name: Cross-index change feed
novel_features.description: Diff status, team_size, or isHiring across the whole index between two snapshots, optionally scoped to specific slugs or target values.
novel_features.rationale: Snapshot-table field diff — subsumes hiring-flipped-true and status-flip detection.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this for any 'who flipped X' question — newly hiring, newly acquired, jumped team size.

novel_features.name: Peer discovery by tags
novel_features.description: Given a YC slug, rank peers by tag overlap, industry match, and batch proximity.
novel_features.rationale: Local Jaccard on tag set + scoring loop. No scraper does similarity; no static endpoint exposes pairwise computation.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when an agent needs competitors or peers for a specific YC company without an LLM-judged similarity call.

novel_features.name: Cross-batch and cross-industry aggregates
novel_features.description: GROUP BY over the local companies table — count, average team size, % hiring, % top, % acquired per cell.
novel_features.rationale: Local SQLite aggregation; static endpoints are single-axis and cannot compute pivots.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this for any 'how has X changed across batches' question — counts, growth, hiring share, team-size trends.

novel_features.name: Batch summary card
novel_features.description: One-shot batch view: company count, top industries, top tags, % hiring, % top company, % acquired, median team size.
novel_features.rationale: Local single-batch projection; one card vs many lines of a raw list.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when an agent or analyst needs a quick read on the shape of a single batch.

narrative.headline: Every YC-backed company in a local database, with watch lists, deltas, and cross-batch stats no scraper has.
narrative.value_prop: Sync the full Y Combinator company directory into a local SQLite store, then filter across batch, industry, tag, status, region, and team size in one query. Watch a portfolio and see what changed between syncs. Compute cross-batch aggregates the live site cannot show.

quickstart.comment: Pull the latest YC directory (5,889 companies, ~5 MB) into local SQLite.
Multi-axis filters work offline; pipe to jq.

quickstart.command: yc-companies-pp-cli watch add stripe airbnb doordash
quickstart.comment: Track a list of slugs locally.
Surface team_size / status / hiring deltas between snapshots.
Cross-batch industry pivot — count, avg team size, % hiring.

troubleshoots.fix: Run `yc-companies-pp-cli sync` first — every read command reads from the local SQLite store.
Watch diff needs at least two snapshots. Run `yc-companies-pp-cli sync` a second time after some upstream data changes; or use `--since <older-date>`.
Use `yc-companies-pp-cli companies search '<name>'` first — slugs are kebab-case derivatives, not human names.
Run `yc-companies-pp-cli doctor` to compare local meta.last_updated against upstream; `yc-companies-pp-cli sync` to refresh.

narrative.when_to_use: Pick this CLI when an agent or analyst needs to filter, search, or compute aggregates across the Y Combinator portfolio without round-tripping through a browser or rewriting the same pandas script. The local SQLite cache makes every cross-axis filter sub-second; the snapshot table makes 'what changed' questions answerable; the tag-Jaccard similar command finds peers without an LLM-judged comparison.

recipes.title: AI companies hiring in SF this batch
recipes.command: yc-companies-pp-cli companies list --batch w25 --tag ai --hiring --region 'United States' --json --select slug,name,one_liner,team_size,website
recipes.explanation: Multi-axis filter with a focused projection — the YC site can't compose these dimensions in one URL.

recipes.title: What's new since last Monday
recipes.explanation: Anti-join across snapshots returns rows present now and absent on the given date.

recipes.title: Companies that started hiring this month
recipes.command: yc-companies-pp-cli companies changes --field isHiring --to true --since 2026-04-01 --json --select slug,name,batch,team_size
recipes.explanation: Hiring-flip detection across snapshots — the recruiter ritual collapsed to one command.

recipes.title: Peers of Stripe by tag overlap
recipes.explanation: Local Jaccard ranking — no LLM, deterministic, sub-second.

recipes.title: Fintech growth across batches
recipes.explanation: Cross-batch pivot — count, avg team_size, % hiring, % top per batch.
